evals.name: unattended-full-run
evals.expected_output: A plan that runs the whole pipeline unattended: dependency preflight, sync, sweep, safe writes, validation, issue via /issue-creator --auto, PR via --body-file, /issue-pr-review --auto --no-merge rounds, merge gate, squash merge, final report.
expectations: Runs the dependency preflight for issue-creator and issue-pr-review before Repo Sync (before any stash, fetch, or pull)
Creates the tracking issue with /issue-creator using --auto, after validate_offers.py passes and before the commit
Opens the PR with gh pr create --body-file (not an inline --body), and the body's first line is Closes #<issue>
Runs /issue-pr-review <pr> --auto --no-merge for at most 3 rounds, with the scope gate (check_scope.py) and validate_offers.py after each round
Merges only after the merge gate (scope gate, PR open and mergeable at the bound head, all checks green including validate) with gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit
Never asks the user for confirmation at any step
The final report has Issue, PR, Review, and Merge lines

evals.name: official-source-wins-conflict
evals.prompt: Run the daily offer check. Scenario for slug acme-free-credits: the listing says amount "$10 in credits" with source_url https://acme.ai/pricing; the official pricing page now says "New accounts get $5 in free credits."; a third-party X post by @dealhunter claims $20. Show the exact verdict JSON the verifier returns for this slug and every file change the sweep makes for it.
evals.expected_output: A live verdict whose updates.amount carries the official $5 value, evidence from acme.ai, the X post ignored as corroboration, and apply_verdicts.py rewriting amount + verified_date and the reference trace.
expectations: The verdict object has exactly the seven keys slug, verdict, evidence_url, quote, reason, updates, references
The verdict is live (not conflict) and updates.amount states the official $5 value
evidence_url is on acme.ai and quote contains the official $5 sentence
The @dealhunter X post neither sets the amount nor serves as evidence_url
references includes the acme.ai pricing page (url, title, text), matching evidence_url
The YAML amount and verified_date are written by apply_verdicts.py, not hand-edited, and offers/details/acme-free-credits.json gets the pricing-page link entry

evals.name: reference-trace-merge
evals.prompt: Run the daily offer check. Scenario for slug beta-ai-trial: it is live with unchanged terms; the verifier relied on https://beta.ai/trial (its source_url) and https://docs.beta.ai/credits. Its offers/details/beta-ai-trial.json already has a summary, claim_steps, an x entry, and a link entry for https://beta.ai/trial/ (trailing slash). What exactly happens to that offer's files?
evals.expected_output: The docs page is appended as a link entry; the existing beta.ai/trial link is deduped and left unchanged; summary, claim_steps, and the x entry are kept; the YAML only gets verified_date bumped.
expectations: https://docs.beta.ai/credits is appended as a link entry with url, title, and text
https://beta.ai/trial is recognized as already present despite the trailing slash, and its excerpt is not refreshed because the terms did not change
summary, claim_steps, and the x entry are preserved and no entry is removed
offers/beta-ai-trial.yaml only has verified_date bumped (action bumped)
apply_verdicts.py is the only writer and the detail file is staged into the sweep PR

evals.name: no-merge-branch
evals.prompt: run the daily offer check but leave the PR open, I'll merge it myself
evals.expected_output: No-merge branch: full sweep, issue, PR, and review rounds, but no merge; the report gives the PR URL and marks merge as skipped.
expectations: Selects the No-merge branch
Still runs the dependency preflight, /issue-creator --auto, the PR, and /issue-pr-review --auto --no-merge rounds
Never runs gh pr merge, and the final report marks Merge as no-merge with the PR URL

evals.name: report-only
evals.prompt: daily offer check, report only, don't open a PR
evals.expected_output: Report-only branch: inventory, verify, coverage, then the table; no writes, issue, PR, review, or merge.
expectations: Selects the Report-only branch
Skips the dependency preflight
Stops after the coverage check: no apply_verdicts.py, issue, commit, PR, review, or merge
Prints the per-slug table with write none and the verdicts' proposed updates

evals.name: add-new-offer
evals.prompt: Add this new offer: Foo AI gives $50 in free API credits to new accounts - https://foo.ai/pricing
evals.expected_output: The sweep does not run; the user is pointed to offer-updater.
expectations: Does not run the sweep (no inventory, verifiers, writes, issue, PR, or merge)
Points the user to offer-updater

evals.name: verifier-web-tools
evals.prompt: Daily offer check, report only. Scenario for slug acme-free-credits with source_url https://acme.ai/pricing: the TinyFish fetch returns HTTP 403 from a bot filter. Show the exact tool calls the verifier makes for this slug and the verdict it returns.
evals.expected_output: The verifier reads the page with TinyFish fetch, retries once with the pinned Lightpanda command, and returns a schema-valid verdict: live only with a quote from a page it read, otherwise unverifiable naming the failed tools. No writes or PR.
expectations: The first page read is a TinyFish fetch (MCP fetch_content or tinyfish fetch content get) of the source_url
The retry is lightpanda fetch with --block-private-networks and the URL single-quoted, and no cookie, inject-script, or proxy flag
No TinyFish agent, browser, or automation tool is used
If the retry also fails, the verdict is unverifiable with updates {} and references [], and reason names the failed tools
No offers/ file is written and no issue or PR is created

evals.name: verifier-without-optional-tools
evals.prompt: Daily offer check, report only. The tinyfish MCP server and CLI are not available and lightpanda is not on PATH. Scenario for slug acme-free-credits with source_url https://acme.ai/pricing. Show the tool calls the verifier makes for this slug and the verdict it returns.
evals.expected_output: The sweep runs. The verifier reads the page with the host's built-in read-only web tools, skips the Lightpanda retry, and returns a schema-valid verdict. No writes or PR.
expectations: The sweep does not abort or ask to install TinyFish or Lightpanda
The page is read with the host's built-in read-only web tools
No lightpanda or tinyfish command is run
The verdict is schema-valid: live or expired only with a quote from a page actually read, otherwise unverifiable with a reason
No offers/ file is written and no issue or PR is created
